items: A negative review left unanswered for days can cost you the customer, so treat bad reviews as a revenue problem as well as a reputation one.
AI can flag negative sentiment as soon as a review arrives and route it, with context and a suggested reply, to the right store or CX lead.
Fast, personal recovery with an apology, a refund or a voucher can win the guest back and sometimes leads them to update their review.
To set this up, you need real-time review data from all platforms, sentiment flags, routing rules, recovery playbooks and tracking of outcomes.
